W3Techs provides information about the usage of various types of technologies on the web.

Our vision

Provide the most reliable, the most extensive and the most relevant source of information on web technology usage.

In our web technology surveys you can see the most popular technologies in these categories. We have no affiliation with any of the technology providers, which we cover in the surveys.
